castOptions.note: Cast it for 4 Calories instead of chakra (its upcast may add Calories: spend them by hand).

castOptions.label: Expansion Crash
castOptions.note: In your Expansion Technique stance: unarmed and weapon damage die +1 step.

system.description:
You temporarily expand your entire body growing in size for the duration as you become Large.

While large, you gain the following benefits:

Advantage on Strength ability checks and saving throws.

Unarmed and Weapon damage you deal is increased by 1d6.

Expansion Crash. Your unarmed and weapon damage die increase by 1 step.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the Chakra cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher increase the calorie cost by +1 and your size instead becomes Huge and the bonus damage becomes 2d6.
